rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone who is fussy, finicky, or affectedly prim.

example.english: They are so prissy about food, picking and choosing and still unable to decide.
example.traditional: 佢食嘢扭扭擰擰，揀嚟揀去都未決定。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sik6 je5 nau2 nau2 ning6 ning6 gaan2 lai4 gaan2 heoi3 dou1 mei6 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person or manner seen as effeminate or sissy.

example.english: Why are you acting so prissy all the time? You do not have a bit of manliness.
example.traditional: 你成日扮到咁乸型，邊有少少男人味呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 baan6 dou3 gam3 naa2 jing4 bin1 jau5 siu2 siu2 naam4 jan2 mei6 aa3
